# OpenTelemetry .NET redistribution provenance

FileMCP references the official NuGet packages:

- `OpenTelemetry` 1.19.1
- `OpenTelemetry.Exporter.OpenTelemetryProtocol` 1.19.1

The license and third-party notice files in this directory were copied from the official `OpenTelemetry` 1.19.1 NuGet package installed by `dotnet restore`. The exporter package at the same version carries the same OpenTelemetry .NET Apache-2.0 license and third-party notices.

These files are copied into Windows release packages by `build_windows_app.ps1`.
